# Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

> > Wikipedia is a free, collaboratively-edited online encyclopedia powered by MediaWiki, containing millions of articles across all areas of human knowledge.

Wikipedia is the world's largest and most-read reference work, built and maintained by a global community of volunteer editors. The site emphasizes free content licensing, collaborative editing, and open access to information for all users.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- Wikimedia Foundation
- MediaWiki
- Free content
- Creative Commons licensing
- Collaborative editing
- Wiki markup
- VisualEditor
- Wikimedia Commons
- Featured articles
- Community portal
- Help resources
- File upload
- Recent changes
- Wikipedia overview

## Getting Started

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia's main homepage featuring featured articles and community stats
- [Wikipedia:About - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): Overview of Wikipedia, its mission, and collaborative editing model
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Wikipedia article about itself covering history, mission, and structure
- [Help:Introduction - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Introduction): Tutorial for new editors on wiki markup, VisualEditor, and formatting

## Navigation & Content Organization

- [Wikipedia:Contents - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Table of contents and navigation guide to Wikipedia's content organization
- [Portal:Current events - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Current_events): Portal aggregating current events, news, and trending topics worldwide
- [Wikipedia:Community portal - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Community_portal): Community hub for collaboration, guidelines, and editing resources

## Help & Documentation

- [Help:Contents - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Contents): Comprehensive help guide covering reading, editing, and Wikipedia basics
- [Wikipedia:File upload wizard - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:File_upload_wizard): Guide for uploading media files with copyright and licensing information
- [Free content - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free_content): Reference on free content licensing, Creative Commons, and copyright

## Support & Community

- [Wikipedia:Contact us - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contact_us): Contact information and support channels for Wikipedia users and donors
- [Talk:Main Page - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Main_Page): Discussion page for Main Page feedback, errors, and contributions

## Optional

- [Recent changes - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChanges): Real-time monitoring of edits and contributions to Wikipedia pages
- [Special pages - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:SpecialPages): Index of special administrative and maintenance pages for Wikipedia
- [Related changes - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChangesLinked/Main_Page): Tool for tracking related changes and monitoring linked pages
- [Friedrich Wilhelm Bollinger - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random): Random article feature linking to encyclopedia content pages
- [Pages that link to "Main Page" - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:WhatLinksHere/Main_Page): Metadata page showing all pages linking to Wikipedia's Main Page
